title: Node Exporter Metrics

fields.name: scrape_interval
fields.description: The rate at which metrics are collected from the host operating system

fields.description: The mount point used to collect process information and metrics

fields.name: filesystem.ignore_mount_point_regex
fields.description: Specify the regex for the mount points to prevent collection of/ignore.

fields.description: Specify the regex for the filesystem types to prevent collection of/ignore.

fields.description: regex to determine which units are included in the metrics produced by the systemd collector
fields.default: It is not applied unless explicitly set

fields.name: systemd_exclude_pattern
fields.description: regex to determine which units are excluded in the metrics produced by the systemd collector

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Tag assigned to records emitted by this input plugin.

description: Prometheus Node Exporter is a popular way to collect system level metrics from operating systems, such as CPU / Disk / Network / Process statistics.
